_provenance.what_this_is: Google's published algorithm-update and feature calendar, compiled by hand from Google-owned sources. Every entry carries its own source URL - that URL, not this file, is the citable fact.
_provenance.verification_done_here: 5 of 32 source URLs were fetched and returned 200 on 2026-08-01, alongside a deliberately fake developers.google.com URL that returned 404 - so the probe discriminates and the sample is meaningful. The remaining 27 were NOT re-fetched. Every entry carries a Google-owned source; check it before citing an entry as fact. 2026-10-03: 21 added/re-dated hand rows had their source fetched (all 200, with a fabricated developers.google.com URL returning 404 as the control), and the consequential claims (GeminiNotebook rename, EEA site-reputation enforcement, gen-AI exclusion control, Mediapartners scope, guide and hasAdultConsideration dates) were read in the page text.
_provenance.coverage_caveat: entries_complete_through is the horizon this calendar was swept to - NOT the date of the spot-check above. Silence about a window after it is absence of coverage, never evidence that nothing happened.
_provenance.how_to_top_up: Run `algoupdates.py sync`: it merges status.search.google.com/incidents.json (exact timestamps, recent) and each product's /history page (every incident since 2021). Documentation and product changes are not on the dashboard - add those by hand, newest last, only with a Google-owned source URL.

policy: Every entry in updates[] must cite a Google-owned URL. Third-party-only claims go in unverified[] with a status, and no script may treat an unverified[] claim as an update. Dashboard incidents are merged by `algoupdates.py sync`; documentation/product/policy rows are added by hand.

updates.notes: 18-day rollout. Third core update of 2025. Reported eCommerce skew per Amsive analysis.

updates.name: February 2026 Discover Update
updates.notes: Official dashboard name: February 2026 Discover update (started Feb 5, ~21d rollout, English/US first). Google's blog framed it as a core update to Discover (not general web Search). Rewards original/in-depth/local content; reduces sensational/clickbait.

updates.notes: Serving was experiencing an issue.

updates.name: March 2026 Spam Update
updates.notes: Fastest spam update on record — 19h30m rollout (completed under a day), days before the March 2026 core update.

updates.name: March 2026 Core Update
updates.notes: Started Mar 27, completed Apr 8 (12-day rollout). First web-Search core update of 2026.

updates.name: Back button hijacking spam policy
updates.notes: New 'malicious practices' spam policy: manipulating browser history to defeat the Back button (incl. third-party ad/library scripts). Announced 2026-04-13; enforcement live since 2026-06-15 (manual actions + automated demotions).

updates.name: FAQ rich results retired
updates.notes: FAQ rich results no longer shown for any site (supersedes the Aug 2023 gov/health restriction). Rich Results Test + report support drops Jun 2026; Search Console API support removed Aug 2026. Use QAPage for genuine single-question pages; FAQPage has no Google SERP benefit.

updates.name: Spam policies update (gen-AI scaled content)
updates.notes: Scaled content abuse now explicitly names 'using generative AI tools to generate many pages without adding value' (and automated transformations like translating). Expired-domain and site-reputation abuse remain.

updates.name: Generative AI optimization guide
updates.notes: Official optimizing-for-generative-AI-features guidance: gen-AI optimization IS SEO; you do NOT need new AI files/markup/Markdown/chunking/AI-rewrites. Google Search ignores llms.txt. Dated from developers.google.com/search/updates ('May 15 Adding a new guide on optimizing for generative AI features'); the llms.txt clarification is its own row (2026-06-15); page last updated 2026-07-10 (verified 2026-10-03).

updates.name: Google I/O 2026: AI Mode updates
updates.notes: Google's last official model naming for AI Mode/AI Overviews is a custom version of Gemini 2.5. AI Mode 1B+ monthly users was reported from Google I/O 2026 keynote coverage; not confirmed on a Google-owned source. New intelligent Search box; Information Agents, generative UI, and agentic checkout rolling out summer 2026.

updates.name: hasAdultConsideration property added
updates.notes: Product variant / Merchant listing; required for adult-oriented products; only supported value https://schema.org/SexualContentConsideration. Date per developers.google.com/search/updates ('May 20', verified 2026-10-03).

updates.name: May 2026 Core Update
updates.notes: Completed June 2, 2026 (~11d21h rollout). Second core update of 2026. Global, all languages. Google: 'a regular update designed to better surface relevant, satisfying content from all types of sites.' Superseded as most-recent by the June 2026 spam update (2026-06-24); still the most recent core update as of 2026-07-02.

updates.name: Search Console Generative AI performance reports
updates.notes: Dedicated AI Overviews + AI Mode (and Discover) gen-AI visibility report. Impressions only (no clicks/CTR/position/query); subset rollout. AI Mode also rolls into standard Performance totals.

updates.name: Guidance on third-party SEO tools, services, and advice
updates.notes: No tool guarantees rankings; third-party tools lack access to Google's internal ranking data; Google doesn't endorse vendors; evaluate AEO/GEO claims vs official guidance; GSC is the first-party source.

updates.name: llms.txt clarification in the AI optimization guide
updates.notes: Google added a note that llms.txt files are not needed for Google Search and do not positively or negatively affect visibility. Verified on the updates page 2026-10-03.

updates.name: June 2026 Spam Update
updates.notes: Started June 24, completed June 26 (~2d1h rollout). Normal spam update, all languages and locations. Most recent confirmed ranking update as of 2026-07-02 (dashboard-verified).

updates.name: Merchant Center video_link serving-eligible
updates.notes: Product video_link attribute becomes serving-eligible; product videos can surface in shopping experiences.

updates.name: AMP links move to publisher hosts
updates.notes: Search sends users directly to publisher-hosted AMP URLs; AMP Viewer, AMP Cache and signed-exchange guidance removed. AMP pages rank like other pages.

updates.name: Merchant listing category and sale duration guidance
updates.notes: Product.category accepts Text or CategoryCode (arrays allowed); sale periods use validFrom plus validThrough or priceValidUntil (ISO 8601).

updates.name: Canonicalization re-evaluation timing clarified
updates.notes: Fixed pages may stay in a duplicate cluster for up to two weeks while canonicalization is re-evaluated - a canonical fix measured at day 3 is not yet a result.

updates.name: NotebookLM fetcher renamed Google-GeminiNotebook
updates.notes: User-triggered fetcher token is now Google-GeminiNotebook. The changelog says Google 'will continue to support the old value'; the user-triggered-fetchers page lists Google-NotebookLM as supported until August 2026. Log parsers must match both. Verified 2026-10-03.

updates.name: Review snippet transparency guideline
updates.notes: No fake reviews, and no incentivized reviews unless the incentive is clearly and prominently disclosed.

updates.name: Search Console platform properties
updates.notes: Verified TikTok, Instagram, X and YouTube accounts can be added as Search Console platform properties.

updates.name: August 2026 spam update
updates.notes: Released the August 2026 spam update, which applies globally and to all languages. The rollout may take a few days to complete.

updates.name: Preferred Sources interactive button
updates.notes: Publishers can add Google's button or a deeplink so readers select the site as a preferred source. A per-user preference, not a documented site-wide ranking signal.

updates.name: AI Mode travel booking and flight price tracking
updates.notes: Flight price tracking with alerts, points/miles pricing, and hotel booking through partners inside AI Mode. A surface change for travel sites, not a ranking change.

updates.name: Site reputation abuse enforcement differs inside the EEA
updates.notes: Announced Aug 28, effective Aug 30: outside the EEA a site reputation manual action affects the violating section; for users inside the EEA its impact does not apply. Still a policy violation everywhere. Verified 2026-10-03.

updates.name: Favicon supported file formats listed
updates.notes: Formats now listed in the guide itself; Google says supported formats did not change.

updates.name: Search generative AI control and gen-AI reports worldwide
updates.notes: A Search Console property setting includes (default) or excludes the site from Search generative AI features (AI Overviews, AI Mode, gen-AI in Discover). Excluded: no links, no grounding, no impressions there. Separate from Google-Extended (training). Gen-AI performance reports reached all sites the same day (support.google.com/webmasters/answer/16984139). CHECK THIS SETTING before reading any AI-visibility absence.

updates.name: Regional differences in Search experience documented
updates.notes: Documentation of country-limited experiences. Aggregator and supplier units are EEA-only; hotel/flight/transport/product carousels also exist in South Africa and Turkiye.

updates.name: CrUX experimental ad metrics
updates.notes: Experimental ad count, ad density and ad weight metrics in CrUX. Not Core Web Vitals; no thresholds.

updates.name: Search profile badge documentation
updates.notes: Claimed Search profiles (profile.google.com/@handle) can be linked with a badge; followers are more likely to see linked content in Discover.

updates.name: Search profiles: multi-brand management, lower US eligibility
updates.notes: Sub-brand profiles from one login; US eligibility threshold 10,000 followers across YouTube, Instagram, X or TikTok.

updates.name: Merchant Center AI performance insights
updates.notes: English queries, AU/CA/IN/NZ/US Merchant Center accounts; organic AI traffic only.

updates.name: Mediapartners-Google crawler scope generalised
updates.notes: Rules addressed to Mediapartners-Google affect several ad products (AdSense, Ad Manager), not only AdSense. Verified 2026-10-03.

updates.name: Aggregator and supplier units add local business queries
updates.notes: EEA only: the units now also appear for local business queries; aggregators participate via the Local POI feed.

updates.name: September 2026 spam update
updates.notes: Released the September 2026 spam update, which applies globally and to all languages. The rollout may take up to two weeks to complete.

updates.name: VideoObject creator and interaction statistics documented
updates.notes: Recommended creator (Person/Organization with name or alternateName); interactionStatistic with Watch/Like/Comment/ShareAction.

updates.name: Search Console web multimodal performance reporting
updates.notes: A multimodal search-type filter (Lens, Circle to Search, image uploads) in the Performance and Gen-AI reports, with export. UI/export only - no verified Search Analytics API `type` value, so gsc.py must not send one.
